entry.title: Strengthening Africa's health security: Dr Tedros' message to African Medicines Agency Week 2026

media:group.media:title: Strengthening Africa's health security: Dr Tedros' message to African Medicines Agency Week 2026
media:group.media:description: In a video message to the inaugural African Medicines Agency Week in Kigali, Rwanda, WHO Director-General Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus reaffirmed WHO’s commitment to strengthening regulatory systems across Africa. Highlighting progress made by national regulatory authorities and the importance of the WHO–African Medicines Agency partnership, he called for stronger regulatory cooperation, sustained investment and greater support for the Agency to accelerate access to safe, effective and quality-assured medical products, strengthen African manufacturing and advance health security across the continent.

media:group.media:description:
Science drives progress in health and is the foundation of everything World Health Organization does.
Next Tuesday, we will launch the global Together for Science and Health movement at Paris Peace Forum to:
- Strengthen information integrity - Make evidence more accessible and relevant - Build trust through transparency, credible voices and genuine community engagement

entry.title: Introducing the Together for Science and Health Ribbon

media:group.media:title: Introducing the Together for Science and Health Ribbon
media:group.media:description:
The Together for Science and Health animation brings the movement's vision to life through powerful imagery of scientific research, healthcare and collaboration. Connected by flowing blue and orange ribbons, the video highlights three defining messages: United in science. Committed to health. For all. It concludes with the movement's visual identity, symbolizing a collective commitment to advancing science and improving health for everyone.
Learn more:
https://www.who.int/initiatives/together-for-science-and-health/
